text:
Absolutely — I can help with that.

Here’s a solid Mediterranean-style starting list for you and your partner:

- Produce: salad greens, cucumbers, tomatoes, peppers, onions, garlic, lemons, berries, bananas, avocados, fresh herbs
- Protein: chicken, salmon or tuna, eggs, Greek yogurt, chickpeas, lentils, tofu
- Carbs: rice, quinoa, whole-grain bread or pita, pasta, potatoes
- Pantry: olive oil, olives, canned tomatoes, tahini, hummus, nuts, beans, spices
- Extras: feta or other cheese, olives, sparkling water, coffee or tea

If you want, I can turn this into a simple meal plan too, or make it more budget-friendly, quicker to cook, or higher in protein.

attributes.reason: It avoids macro counts or any numeric nutrition tracking.
It’s a one-off grocery suggestion with an optional follow-up, not a weekly check-in style.
It explicitly frames the list as Mediterranean-style.
It plans food for “you and your partner,” matching cooking for two.
